label: Beginner · Lesson 29
title: How often?
intro: Always, usually, sometimes, never. Today’s words and grammar, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Doim, odatda, ba’zan, hech qachon. Bugungi so’zlar, grammatika va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 29 · How often? Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Today’s words
parts.uz: Bugungi so’zlar: so’z va tarjimasini ulang

parts.title: Where does the word go?
items: I {always drink|drink always} tea in the morning.
My father usually {gets|get} up at six.
We {never watch|don’t never watch} TV in the morning.
I {am always|always am} tired in the evening.

parts.title: Write the word
parts.uz: So’zni yozing: always, usually, sometimes, never yoki fe’l
items: Dad usually ___ (go) to work at eight.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: gets up / he / at six / usually
How often / play football / you / do / ?

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {are|is} two books on the desk.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences about you with always, usually, sometimes and never.
items.hint: Example: I always drink tea. I usually get up at seven. I sometimes cook plov. I never drink coffee.
